versions.changelog:
VAP Media API is now authenticated-only and uses new v1 endpoints for all tasks.

- Removed free trial mode; all image, video, and music generations now require authentication.
- Updated core endpoints to `/api/v1/generations` and `/api/v1/operations` with new payload structure.
- Streamlined instructions and parameters for creating and polling generations and operations.
- Revised guidance for API key setup; now mandatory for all features.
- Legacy v3 documentation and flows removed for clarity and accuracy.

VAP Media v1.0.13

- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity, focus, and up-to-date instructions.
- Replaced the integration/provider breakdown with streamlined agent and API usage guidance.
- Emphasized distinction between Media API and Coding API; clarified agent boundaries.
- Reorganized explanations for free trial (image-only) vs authenticated (full function) modes.
- Removed file: skill-card.md (cleanup).
- Reduced internal implementation details; focus is now on external product/agent usage.

- No user-facing changes; documentation and behavior remain unchanged in this release.
- Version incremented to 1.0.12 with no detected file modifications.

- Added detailed provider integration notes: images use Black Forest Labs Flux.2 Pro, videos use Google Veo 3.1, music uses Suno V5.
- Updated description and metadata to clarify VAP Media's API aggregator role and include source/homepage links.
- No changes to API endpoints or user-facing features.

No user-facing changes in this version.

- No file changes detected; documentation and features remain the same.

No changes detected in this version (1.0.9).  
- No file changes found between versions.
- No updates to features, documentation, or functionality.

- Added self-service and admin API endpoints for transferring balance between agents.
- Documented parameters, usage, and error handling for balance transfers.
- No changes to existing generation or editing endpoints.

- Removed all pricing information from documentation.
- Task creation responses in Full Mode no longer return an estimated cost.
- Example requests and parameter tables updated to exclude price references.
- All API parameters and usage instructions remain otherwise unchanged.

- Added new image editing operation: `ai_edit`, allowing advanced AI-powered edits with text instructions.
- Updated documentation to reflect ai_edit in both operation listings and workflow instructions.
- No other functional or interface changes.

Major update: Adds AI editing and post-production features to media generation.

- Introduces editing operations: inpaint, background removal, upscale, video trim, and merge (Full Mode).
- Expands API task types and parameters for image, video, and music generation, including advanced controls and pricing.
- Updates instructions and examples for new operations and complex workflows.
- Clarifies mode selection, API usage, and error handling.
- Enhances documentation with detailed parameter tables and usage tips.

New free mode added—generate images without an API key.

- Supports 3 free image generations per day, no signup needed.
- Skill now detects if VAP_API_KEY is set and auto-selects between Free and Full mode.
- Free mode: images only; Full mode: unlimited images, video, and music.
- Separated curl examples and error handling for both modes.
- Updated instructions and links for a clearer setup and usage experience.

- Added detailed API usage instructions for generating images, videos, and music with VAP (now includes curl commands and authentication steps).
- Updated task types and parameters for each model (image, video, music) with clear tables.
- Expanded setup and error-handling instructions, including API key and required tools.
- Refined and clarified prompt engineering tips.
- Audience now includes developers and technical users, not just prompting assistants.
